en.name: Home lab
en.purpose: An ongoing personal infrastructure lab where I investigate the layers around an application in practice: virtual machines, segmented networks, VPNs, firewalls, containers, Kubernetes, identity and observability.
en.status: Investigation · ongoing · repository content to update
en.body: This entry is intentionally kept as a CMS draft for now. The current lab has evolved beyond what the older public repository documents, and I do not want the portfolio to imply that the repository is a complete or reproducible description of the current environment. The public Infrastructure & Cluster Notebook documents individual investigations more accurately while this broader lab record catches up.
